description: Exhaustive specification of allowed vocabulary translations and format normalizations performed by the benchmark runner.

transformations.reason: Production scanner uses internal rule IDs; maps direct or prefixed IDs to capability catalog rule IDs
transformations.enrichment_justification: Direct 1-to-1 vocabulary mapping; does not create, modify, or verify defect predicates

transformations.input_source: Finding.start_line / end_line + manifest AST symbol table
transformations.reason: Production static scanner operates on raw tokens/lines; encloses finding within AST function/class name for symbol localization evaluation
transformations.enrichment_justification: Deterministic AST geometry lookup from submitted code; does not infer defects or synthesize evidence

transformations.reason: Maps sink_kind (SQLI, CMDI, PATH_TRAVERSAL) to INTERPROCEDURAL_FLOW_* catalog rule identifiers
transformations.enrichment_justification: Direct vocabulary translation of production flow detector category; no synthetic filtering

transformations.reason: Maps bug candidate kind to catalog rule identifiers (BROAD_EXCEPTION_SWALLOW, BLOCKING_API_IN_ASYNC, UNENFORCED_AUTH_HEADER, UNCHECKED_PERMISSION)
transformations.enrichment_justification: Vocabulary translation of production candidate kind; line ranges and files preserved exactly

transformations.reason: Extracts relative file path from candidate evidence references when top-level file_path is omitted
transformations.enrichment_justification: Format extraction of path string already present in production candidate object

transformations.reason: Translates structured diff engine deltas into CONTRACT_* benchmark findings and fact dictionaries
transformations.enrichment_justification: Deterministic projection of production structural diff fields; no heuristic inference

transformations.reason: Maps blast radius node/edge impact entries to IMPACT_* benchmark evaluation findings
transformations.enrichment_justification: Deterministic formatting of graph reachability outputs; preserves source and target symbols verbatim

transformations.input_source: Multiple candidate/finding emitters traversing overlapping AST scopes
transformations.reason: Consolidates findings that represent the identical physical semantic fact (same rule_id, file_path, symbol, start_line)
transformations.enrichment_justification: Preserves 1-to-1 semantic fact correspondence without altering finding attributes

transformations.input_source: Raw string file paths from all production components
transformations.reason: Standardizes Windows backslashes, leading slashes, and case casing for cross-platform deterministic evaluation
transformations.enrichment_justification: Platform-neutral path canonicalization; no path alteration
